data.name: No Barrel Shadow
data.teaser: Removes the barrel shadow cast by flashlights and tactical devices on all weapons.
data.description:
Description

Removes the distracting barrel shadow that flashlights and other weapon Light attachments cast onto nearby surfaces.

Also Adjust brightness and intensity of each individual flashlight via the sliders in F12.

Install Instructions
  1. Extract the archive
  2. Drop the BepInEx folder into your SPT root directory
  3. Launch the game — no configuration needed, works automatically
Known Limitations / Bugs

  • On the MP7A1 and MP7A2, switching your flashlight to a different rail mid-raid will cause the shadow to reappear. Toggle the light off and back on once to fix it immediately.

  • There’s Now an API for other mod authors to create addons for their custom flashlights they make, so if you have modded lights and they don’t make an addon then you won’t be able to adjust your light, but it’ll retain its default values.

Support

Found a bug or have a question? Leave a comment on this mod’s page, or reach out in my thread on the SPT Discord: https://discord.com/channels/875684761291599922/1521972310595338260

versions.description:
**Requires SPT 4.1.x.** This build will not load on 4.0.x — stay on [v1.1.0](https://github.com/Vultify/NoBarrelShadow/releases/tag/v1.1.0) if you are still on 4.0.

### Added
- Range and intensity sliders now take effect as you drag them. Previously the new value sat unused until the light happened to be toggled off and on, which made tuning them guesswork — set a value, see the beam change, done.

### Changed
- Rebuilt against the deobfuscated SPT 4.1 client assemblies

### Install
Extract into your SPT root folder. Lands as `BepInEx/plugins/NoBarrelShadow/`.

-Delete old version before installing this new one!

- NEW FEATURE: Each light now has its OWN F12 sliders! Fine-tune the range and intensity of every flashlight individually, right from F12 (if your light is on while adjusting, turning it off and back on will apply the changes.)

- Natively supports every vanilla flashlight plus all of *WTT Content Backport's* added lights out of the box, no setup needed

- Added a public API so other mod authors can create add-ons and hook their own lights into the F12 menu instantly, with their own custom name.

- Fixed AI flashlights and dropped guns with lights on bleeding through walls and geometry

- Added debug logging toggle in F12 settings (for bug reporting)

- Known issue: MP7A1 and MP7A2 — switching your flashlight to a different rail mid-raid causes the shadow to reappear. Toggle the light off and back on once to fix it

- Also update profile mod page picture tehehe
Initial release — removes barrel shadows cast by flashlights and tactical devices on all weapons and mount positions.
